title: Vice President of Quality
text:
**Overview**

The Vice President of Quality provides strategic leadership and oversight of all quality functions, ensuring products and manufacturing processes meet customer requirements, applicable quality standards, and company expectations. This position is responsible for developing and executing the company's quality strategy, maintaining an effective quality management system, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring customer satisfaction.

The VP of Quality partners with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to improve manufacturing performance, reduce quality-related costs, resolve complex quality issues, and establish a culture of accountability and operational excellence.

Direct semiconductor manufacturing experience is required. The successful candidate must have 10–15 years of progressive quality experience, including experience in semiconductor equipment manufacturing, with a demonstrated ability to lead quality initiatives and deliver measurable improvements in product quality, process performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Duties**

- Develop and implement the company's quality strategy, objectives, and improvement initiatives in alignment with business goals.

- Provide executive leadership and oversight for all Quality department functions, personnel, systems, and processes.

- Establish, implement, and maintain an effective quality management system in accordance with applicable ISO standards, customer requirements, and industry standards.

- Ensure products and manufacturing processes meet established specifications, customer expectations, and applicable quality requirements.

- Serve as a senior point of contact for customer quality concerns, escalations, audits, corrective actions, and quality performance reviews.

- Manage root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to prevent recurring quality issues.

- Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators, identify trends, and implement improvement plans to reduce defects, scrap, rework, and quality-related costs.

- Partner with Operations, Engineering, Production, and other departments to resolve manufacturing issues and improve process consistency.

- Oversee internal and external quality audits, supplier quality performance, nonconformance management, and compliance activities.

- Ensure appropriate quality resources, inspection equipment, measurement systems, work instructions, and technical documentation are available and maintained.

- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Quality organization with clear performance expectations, accountability, and development plans.

- Promote a culture of quality, teamwork, continuous improvement, and shared responsibility across the organization.

- Report quality performance, significant risks, customer concerns, and improvement initiatives to executive leadership.

- Evaluate quality risks and make sound decisions using technical analysis, available data, customer impact, and business priorities.

- Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, reduce waste, and optimize the use of company resources.

- Maintain effective communication and coordination among Quality, Manufacturing, customers, and suppliers.

- Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Knowledge and Skills

- Extensive knowledge of quality assurance, quality engineering, quality management systems, and manufacturing process controls.

- Direct knowledge and experience with semiconductor manufacturing quality requirements and production processes.

- Strong understanding of statistical process control (SPC), process capability studies, metrology, statistical analysis, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action methodologies.

- Experience implementing quality systems, managing audits, and driving continuous improvement.

- Ability to interpret technical specifications, engineering drawings, inspection requirements, and manufacturing documentation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex issues and implement effective solutions.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence stakeholders, and establish accountability throughout an organization.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings and quality performance to executive leadership, customers, and employees.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and quality reporting and data analysis tools.

- Ability to balance customer expectations, product quality, operational efficiency, and business objectives.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- 7–10 years of progressive quality engineering and quality leadership experience, including direct experience in semiconductor equipment manufacturing.

-Black belt or Green belt certification.

- Semiconductor manufacturing experience is mandatory. General manufacturing quality experience alone does not meet this requirement.

- Demonstrated experience leading quality functions or significant quality initiatives within a semiconductor manufacturing environment.

- Experience with manufacturing process controls, defect reduction, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement.

- Experience managing customer quality requirements, customer and supplier audits, nonconformances, and corrective action programs.

- Proven ability to lead and develop teams, establish strategic priorities, and deliver measurable improvements in product quality and customer satisfaction.

- Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and decision-making skills.

**Responsibility for Work of Others**

Provides executive leadership and oversight for the Quality department, including Quality managers, supervisors, engineers, inspectors, and other quality personnel, as applicable. Establishes departmental objectives, assigns responsibilities, evaluates performance, and ensures adequate staffing, training, and resources to meet company and customer requirements.

**Additional Information**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as business needs require.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
